title: Authorized full reproduction of supervised LanternQuest entity and relation extraction
rerun_rule: All baseline predictions and every learned out-of-fold prediction are regenerated after authorization. No E27v2 or E27v3 prediction or metric file is used as a result input.

evaluation.boundary: internal record-level cross-validation, not source-held-out external validation

methods: staged BERT with early ontology-compatible candidate construction
matched BERT neural-only, ontology-mask and evidence-gate variants
matched MacBERT neural-only, ontology-mask and evidence-gate variants
shared-encoder joint BERT neural-only, ontology-mask and evidence-gate variants
reporting: Report the complete rerun regardless of whether values match earlier exploratory runs.
Report authorization ID and local-only processing boundary in Methods and Data governance.
Do not claim public-benchmark state of the art from the private corpus.
